translations.answer: Humanoid-Gym demonstrated a closed-loop engineering system that first uses a simulator calibrated against real actuator responses to perform cross-engine validation, followed by zero-shot deployment to two XBot sizes. This validation is suitable as a pre-fault screening layer, but the evidence is insufficient to consider cross-engine validation as a real-world safe or successful guarantee.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: A second simulator can be calibrated against real actuator responses.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: The policy interface and robot model are represented consistently across engines.
translations.confidence_rationale: The method and two-hardware deployment are documented and the official code is public, but the paper lacks quantitative success/failure statistics and only gives qualitative calibration curves.
